title: Climb Until You're High Enough
brief:
A loop can watch where you are instead of counting flags:

  • position_x() — which column you are standing in, counting from 0 at the left edge.
  • position_y() — which row you are standing in, counting from 0 at the top. Climbing makes this number go down.

You start in row 6 and the top of the staircase is row 2. Keep jumping while your row number is still bigger than 2, then walk the last tile.

Try say(position_y()) inside the loop if you want to watch the number change as you climb.
